campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine: Priority: improve robustness and cut gate, automation and runtime wall time and peak memory by consolidating duplicated logic into fewer general components, never by adding instrumentation or a framework. Net AST nodes stay flat or fall: every addition deletes at least as much, a new general component replaces the copies it subsumes, and the clone and harness ratchets hold the floor. Do safe, behavior-preserving consolidations first, the ones existing tests and the ratchets already cover; take deeper execution-core and command-surface simplification behind the model-regression baseline so a removal never loses proven behavior. Preserve the capability freeze enforced by structure: no new model family, workflow, optimizer or orchestration framework. Preserve acceptance and independent model progress; these priorities add no automation prerequisite to model validation. Document order ranks ready work; depends_on names actual producers. A step's machine check is its verify, set with plan -setverify; a check whose real prerequisite cannot run records UNAVAILABLE rather than a pass. GUI and audio retain their lanes. Master execution proceeds under role master-lead. docs/plan.json is the sole live plan.

items.title: Narrow what a confined landing re-runs, by a contract that is verified rather than by syntax alone (findings of 2026-09-21, read with plan -history -phases): a landing confined to one command runs about 29 packages, 28 of them because they import a library charged with an unnamed reach, for about 170 s of work and 80 s of wall. Two rules were tried on evidence. Inheritance narrowing, measured in shadow on three landings, would leave out 1 of 29. Judging a forwarded path at its call site would clear the foundation libraries whose functions open a path they are handed (atomicfile, fsatomic, jsonfile, processlock), but 24 of the 29 packages also import overgodb, and artifact, gitauthority, gosource and repoanalysis behind it, which hold a root in a struct and join paths under it, and no syntactic rule follows that soundly. The code anticipates a declared runtime contract and none exists. Design one that is checked, not trusted -- a package declares that its reach is confined to roots its callers supply, and its tests run under a guard that fails on a read outside them -- or record the files a package's tests actually opened as the inputs of its receipt; keep the shadow measure and the reader ranking as the before and after. Ranked below the suite walls: the ceiling here is about 80 s on a narrow landing, while audioparity alone is 6 min 45 s of every broad one

steps.verify: go test ./internal/longform -count=1 && test -f cmd/longform/accepted_baseline_test.go && go test ./cmd/longform -run '^TestAcceptedBaselineEvidence$' -count=1
steps.rationale: After guarded defect fixes, the chat rung and initial modality evidence, expand the accepted baseline to the available full text catalog, both prompt shapes, required contexts, rates and peak/retained memory under explicit budgets. Preserve unavailable/failed dimensions with dispositions. Compare to initial guard and pre-fix evidence under identical inputs and declared bounds; pin accepted record IDs. Bind the actual catalog denominator and read-only completeness/non-regression assertion through longform before closure. Preserve historical records. Use existing run-record and training owners, group compatible cases per residency, publish completed cells once and retain missing cells as explicit obligations.

steps.verify: test -f cmd/benchmark-report/accepted_coverage_test.go && OVERGO_DATA_ROOT=C:/Users/jeffm/overgo go test ./cmd/benchmark-report -run '^TestAcceptedPublishedComparison$' -count=1 && go run ./cmd/benchmark-report -check
steps.rationale:
Compare all required suite/model/protocol cells with declared references and local lm-eval oracle records. Compare as equivalent only when checkpoint/precision, dataset split/cases, shot count, template, scoring/generation protocol and answer extraction agree; otherwise label the protocol difference, not a performance regression. For Gemma same-checkpoint comparisons, build the Gemma-capable llama.cpp revision when required and pin it with precision/template/protocol; missing reference evidence is a labeled comparison gap, not a prerequisite for the regression baseline. Dispatch contract: retain the current verifier as a lower bound, but bind executable assertions for the exact required denominator, identities, protocols, thresholds and outcomes described above before work starts. If missing, add the smallest read-only assertion to the existing owner and prove its failing counterexample before publishing evidence. A bare freshness/listing/lane command cannot close this row.

Implement this bound assertion before the row can close; it must reject an omitted required cell, duplicate case, stale identity and failed required outcome using the stated denominator, protocols and thresholds. Existing lane/report checks remain lower bounds. Aggregate existing per-model evidence and acquire only missing or invalidated cells; do not rebuild an evaluation engine or launch long benchmarks from this assertion.

BBH comparison must distinguish native raw likelihood, native chat likelihood and the existing generated-letter-opener protocol. Preserve the 5761-case generated result as such. Native raw compilation is owned by modality-verification/bbh-protocol. Before claiming native chat parity, reproduce the native system description, combined user demonstrations and question, actual template tokens, likelihood method and character normalization. Reuse the captured 24-task/72-example reference; no cross-protocol score substitution.

items.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness

steps.title: Recover small-head decode throughput without losing long-context correctness
steps.rationale: The reviewed short-context Qwen2.5-0.5B rate fell from 295 to 139 tokens/s while E4B remained within about three percent. First remove capacity-sized host upload from BenchmarkDecodeAttention's timed iteration and keep caches resident; measure allocation/upload separately. Run the actual benchmark with -bench '^BenchmarkDecodeAttention$' and device opt-in, not only -run. Compare repeated isolated before/after runs across short contexts, 4096 boundaries, tile boundaries, long contexts and representative head geometries. Keep split-key correctness, NLL and memory guarantees; recover the measured short-context gap within predeclared noise bounds without trading away larger-context throughput. Bind both kernel parity and end-to-end Qwen/E4B assertions. Remove capacity-wide work and redundant transfers before introducing another dispatch policy; retain one shared path wherever parity permits. The MiniCPM guard repair now owns the initial block-width split derivation and per-split shared allocation. Consume that landed producer and its measurements; do not implement a competing split policy. Close any remaining performance claim only with the prescribed model/geometry comparison.

steps.title: Exercise rollback, quarantine, peer failures and durable workflow recovery
steps.rationale:
Use scratch stores/peers to exercise escalation, candidate quarantine and evidence-bound re-entry, exact predecessor rollback, peer timeout/partial response and workflow restart with persistent obligations. Inject failure before and after side effects/receipt publication; assert state, lineage, idempotence and absence of duplicate mutations. Bind executable drill tests using existing loop/agent-loop owners. A successful build is not a recovery result. Remaining caller coverage: inventory production nonblocking OvergoDB.Open uses and migrate normal service/command startup to the existing OpenContext entry point with the caller's cancellation, retaining immediate refusal only for intentional probes. Gate admission/recovery and closure publication are handled by admission-recovery; reuse that owner and its release/cancellation tests. Do not add caller-specific retry loops, timers or wrappers. Bind live workbench plus simultaneous writers, normal completion, error, queued cancellation and process death; report remaining unmigrated callers. This follow-up cannot force re-acquisition of unrelated completed model evidence.

Prove release-triggered progress under expected parallel contention. Bind queued writers to actual OS ownership; process death releases ownership without stale-file or PID-age heuristics. Cover release before waiter registration, release during cancellation, multiple queued writers, duplicate cleanup, and a surviving child that still owns work. Cancellation must drain pending native waits before returning; publish not_busy only after owned handles are released. Recheck the ownership predicate after every wakeup; notifications alone never authorize a write. Distinguish the landed Windows store-writer completion wait from the still-polled GPU AwaitResource admission path. Inventory remaining polling in its existing owner, replace it only with a proved release/process-lifetime trigger, and preserve shared correctness admission plus isolated performance runs. Do not claim all resource waits are event-driven, introduce per-caller retries, or use elapsed time as evidence that an owner is dead.

Connect deferred findings to prerequisites and reconsideration triggers through the existing observation/candidate owners. A changed prerequisite should propose one bounded experiment with a causal hypothesis and fixed acceptance; coalesce duplicate observations and retain rejected evidence. Stops remain operator-controlled, budgets cumulative, and unrelated eligible work continues after one candidate fails. Exercise restart between observation, proposal, admission and result; use the media experiment-resume records instead of acquiring a second demonstration.

steps.title: Interrupt and recover the gate in a scratch clone

Run the existing recover-preparation, recover-interrupted and watchdog paths against an isolated scratch clone/store. Assert exact source/index/HEAD, plan step and durable receipt state after interruptions at transaction boundaries; prohibit duplicate commit/advance. Reuse the evidence-commit-recovery integration and its persisted receipts; this row extends the existing transaction-boundary drill, never introduces a second supervisor or recovery path. Include a semantic failure that must not be retried, and preserve exact failure diagnostics.

steps.title: Unify measured prefill policy where reference parity permits

items.title: Consolidate public APIs and shipped binaries after their contract prerequisites

steps.title: Migrate callers and remove duplicated API and executable owners
steps.rationale:
Consume command-discovery's source-derived purpose/audience/flags and actual build inventory. Use operator-facing versus automation-internal roles to rank redundant binaries and APIs by real callers, not suffix or the historical 102 count. Public help/discovery repairs can land independently; binary deletion still requires the caller migration and contract evidence below. Require a capability-scoped removal result. Consume the early common-owner inventory; rank remaining duplicate APIs and shipped command binaries by repeated build, verification, startup, packaging and maintenance cost. Before dispatch choose a concrete duplicated owner and bind the old-to-new caller/operation map. Migrate code, automation, installation/release manifests and human references in the same integration batch; remove the displaced implementation, exports and build target. A dispatcher over unchanged handlers can earn measured packaging/discovery savings, but cannot satisfy this row's ownership-consolidation acceptance without removing duplicated implementation or policy. Preserve public version/flag/schema/exit, streaming, cancellation, credentials, resource lifetime and evidence contracts through independent cases. TestOwnershipConsolidationContracts must reject stale invocation/import/release references and duplicate policy reintroduction, and prove reduced relevant API or executable surface plus retained behavior.

Report exported symbols, wrappers, command packages, actually shipped executables and bytes separately. Compare build/test dependency closure and compile/link/startup costs before and after; do not merge unrelated backends into a binary that forces unused GPU/native dependencies on CPU-only consumers. Keep compatibility shims only for declared external callers with an explicit retirement obligation. Gate public/numerical changes by affected contracts; do not make unrelated catalog validation a new prerequisite for the early internal automation pilot.

Consume the common-owner-pilot's call/effect and caller-migration map. Rank remaining parallel paths by duplicated policy and measured maintenance/verification cost, not textual clones alone. Separate actual shared responsibility from numerical, lifecycle or protocol differences. Consolidate one capability at a time, migrate consumers and delete displaced APIs in the same batch; avoid combining unrelated helpers merely to reduce package count. Keep all existing regression, modality, benchmark and recovery prerequisites for this broader public-surface work.

Inventory actual overlapping wrappers rather than assume a fixed command count. Fold probe/lane/parity entrypoints into typed subcommands only where ownership/maintenance cost falls; preserve every behavior, flag contract, exit code and evidence path. Preserve plan, gate, loop and hook responsibilities and their required invocation contracts; separate binaries are justified by actual consumer, isolation or lifecycle requirements, not historical names alone. Atomically update plan verifiers, CI, scripts, API manifest and docs with an old-to-new invocation map; no later row may reference a removed command. Keep README's transport descriptions aligned with registered adapters. Validate all migrated invocation contracts plus representative real dispatch and record the reduced command/duplication ceilings. Avoid rerunning expensive model suites when an exact implementation-independence proof permits evidence reuse. Consolidate only shared responsibilities whose callers can migrate atomically with lower measured maintenance cost; distinct responsibilities remain separate. Command-count reduction alone is not acceptance.

Select the first consolidation from measured duplicated responsibilities in model lookup, admission, input resolution or evidence publication. Freeze the caller/contract inventory and before cost; migrate every affected caller, remove the displaced implementation and prove equivalent success/refusal/exit/evidence behavior through TestOwnershipConsolidationContracts in internal/apimanifest. Assert that generated invocation references resolve and duplicate ownership cannot reappear. A renamed executable or a new dispatcher around unchanged duplication is insufficient.

Align skill.md durable automation policy with the campaign decision: the second manual repetition triggers review of the existing owner, not mandatory creation of another command. Prefer removal of manual work or extension of an existing typed operation; require demonstrated recurring need and explicit ownership before admitting a new public entrypoint. Preserve deterministic verification and durable receipts. Include this policy alignment and net surface/caller accounting in the same bounded consolidation; broader HTTP implementation remains GUI-owned.

Include the landed providerintake, remoteprovider, remoterelay and modelrecipe admission paths in the ownership census. Consolidate duplicated model lookup, credentials or admission only when measured duplication and atomic caller migration justify it; keep provider declaration, credential storage and wire transport responsibilities explicit. Coordinate HTTP caller migration with the GUI lane. Do not add a new public wrapper or defer E4B to perform this cleanup.

The earlier evidence-commit-recovery slice owns narrowly necessary gate-wrapper removal; consume its ownership map rather than inventory or implement it again. This later row handles only remaining measured duplication. Delete displaced retry, timeout, input-resolution and evidence-publication policy with all callers; require end-to-end success/refusal/cancellation/exit/evidence parity and lower ownership/surface cost. Do not add wrapper-count targets or a new registry.

Audit automatic Markdown writers and their readers in benchmark-report, compatibility (model/media/training), api-manifest, plan sync, preflight and release. Prefer existing typed JSON/OvergoDB results as the single operational authority; machine consumers must not scrape prose. Remove stray generated plans/status/handoffs and redundant report persistence with all callers, while retaining deliberate human documentation and third-party model cards/licenses. Keep optional report rendering explicit. Bind migration acceptance to structured schema validation, equivalent decisions and denominators, missing/invalid record refusal, release/link contracts and absence of unsolicited Markdown writes. Do not create a parallel JSON file for every retired Markdown file or duplicate stored results.

Audit follow-up and sequencing: consume the CLI boundary, consumer-rule proof and early owner pilot. At first dispatch split remaining work into capability-sized implementation steps with one acceptance/integration owner each; retain this parent and its prerequisites until all assigned migrations are accounted for. Rank one command family by measured repeated build, execution, verification and operator cost; do not launch a 102-to-40 binary campaign or treat that estimate as a floor. Candidates are database maintenance, lane execution, declared training probes, and format/model tools. Select shared responsibility, dependencies and lifecycle before command spelling. Avoid a giant train or preflight binary that forces unrelated native/GPU backends into every invocation. CPU-only tools and deliberate process/privilege boundaries stay separate when needed.

Database maintenance must reuse canonical transaction, integrity and recovery owners while preserving operation-specific read/write access, CRC/chain validation, crash recovery, backup consistency and concurrent readers. Combining command names does not repair unsafe rebuild/swap or repair paths. Reproduce and correct any real integrity defect with its immediate persistence acceptance; it does not wait for the larger consolidation. Lane migration shares real skip/zero-match/evidence/cancellation policy while retaining distinct resource and protocol requirements. Training probes may share declared dispatch without acquiring every training backend; preserve their actual production paths and independent acceptance.

HTTP remains GUI-owned. Before any route removal or advertisement change, bind the actual launcher/provider path, real consumers and external compatibility claim in the existing route/API manifest owner. Distinguish operational, implemented-but-unwired, compatibility-required and retired surfaces; a missing provider or 501 response alone does not authorize deletion. Resolve automation, peers, export, video edits and unrouted composition handlers by connecting intended capability or recording an explicit staged/retirement disposition. Alias families retain one canonical admission/handler policy; migrate known callers and preserve declared external compatibility with a retirement trigger for temporary aliases. Bind provider-present/provider-absent, authentication, method/side-effect and alias-equivalence acceptance to internal/server before editing. Correct README claims in the same batch. A read-only disposition can proceed independently of model evidence; public behavior changes retain their affected prerequisites. No fixed route-count target.

Library-only exports require caller, external-contract and staged-capability review before removal or unexporting. Test-only use, test-line counts and file ceilings are review signals, not evidence of uselessness. Preserve or explicitly retire unfinished inference/session/cache, training, transport and agent recovery obligations through existing staged-surface authority; never claim deletion as capability validation.

GUI follow-up remains lane-owned. Merge 99c142ee8d07 imports committed GUI fe9c59a6 while retaining master's plan. It corrects the reviewed boundary defects in their existing owners: numeric request presence preserves declared defaults and explicit zero; common composer invalidation aborts transcription on clear/dispose/removal; video Front/Rear selection reaches getUserMedia facingMode. TestRequestSamplingPresence covers 25 scalar fields with omitted/zero/nonzero cases and rejects invalid explicit zero; it failed before the repair and passes after it. Focused browser transcription/video cases pass, including late-result isolation after disposal and Rear camera constraints. These are scoped handler/browser results, not new model-quality or physical-device acceptance. Consume the merge's receipts; do not recreate these repair rows. The intake also lands declared video-output delivery, retired video-edit surface, cross-site GET protection, launcher/refusal visibility and projector-separated Library validation. HTTP requests that omit sampling values now use declared defaults; scope affected protocol comparisons to this changed resolution path rather than invalidating unrelated CLI/model acquisitions. Use cheap Go handler/constructor cases for sampler/provider/admission contracts and focused JavaScript/browser cases for camera/abort wiring; do not force model acquisition for pure UI cleanup. Consolidate route/consumer and capability/action declarations in existing manifest owners, with typed required interfaces, strict boundary decoding plus semantic validation and independently retained behavior cases. Derive client-call facts from supported JS analysis; unresolved dynamic calls retain explicit coverage. Go AST analysis alone cannot prove JS behavior. Avoid another hand-maintained declaration table or generated DESIGN.md freshness gate. Coordinate incremental accepted GUI bundles, reuse their independent receipts and reserve comprehensive coverage/device signoff for the final join; new training/style/speculative features must not retroactively invalidate accepted capture or conversation bundles. No master assumption of the lane's open feature plan.
